overview.description: The Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows ETF (CALF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows index. The fund tracks an index of 100 companies out of the S&P Small Cap 600 Index selected and weighted by free cash flow. CALF was launched on Jun 16, 2017 and is issued by Pacer.
